Luca: Half-time report: my bracket is crying and my fantasy team is doing that thing where hope and panic coexist. :crazy_face:
Harper: What happened? who blew up?
Mina: Gobert got benched in the 2nd for foul trouble and my center spot is a literal void. :scream:
Dustin: Also someone in my league streamed a random G-league call-up and now hes my hero. math is broken.
Luca: For clarity, my lineup going into the game:
```
PG: Holiday
SG: Sexton
SF: RookieRim
PF: StretchMcGee
C: Gobert
BN: DeepBench, MorningStreamer
```
Harper: That Gobert benching hurt. you could cry into the office snack tray.
Mina: Also poll: halftime upset pick — React: 🟢 I still believe / 🟡 Bye-bye hope / 🔴 Sell the team / 🔵 Keep calm
Dustin: 🔵 Keep calm. Its early.
Luca: 🟢 I still believe. sports are cruel but forgiving.
bench-bot: "bench-bot: Reminder: waiver window closes at 11:50pm PT. Unclaimed players will be processed at 11:55pm."
Mina: Can we also talk about the snack table arrangement? last week someone swapped the hummus and jalapeo dip and chaos ensued.
Harper: proposal: label all dips with initials and an allergy sticker. small changes, fewer battlefield injuries.
Dustin: trade question: anyone want RookieRim + 1.08 for Harper's stretch big? DM me. Lowball but desperate.
Luca: Also FYI I will host a tiny watch party next Thursday in the common room. BYO foam finger and tolerance for bad takes.
Mina: GIF: tiny crowd cheering (link)
Harper: End thread: if anyone wants to negotiate trades, swap streaming tips, or sign up for next week's snack rota, DM me. Good luck to bracket survivors and bench-lamenters.
